title: The Potential and Justifications for Taxing Wealth in Kenya
summary: Proposes an annual tiered wealth tax on about 7,200 high-net-worth individuals: 1.5% on USD 1-3m, 3% on USD 3-100m and 5% above USD 100m, estimated at USD 781m a year.

title: 'Tax the Rich!': Can Kenya Get Wealth Taxation Right?
by: Institute of Public Finance (author: Daniel Murakaru), with Oxfam in Kenya
summary: Cites an Oxfam estimate that a well-structured wealth tax could raise over USD 1bn a year and recommends a sequenced path (wealth database, voluntary disclosure, incremental reforms) toward an eventual net wealth tax; it does not call for immediate introduction.
